stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.8 — Prospective Primitive-detour Holdout, Algorithm-aware Null Court & Phase-boundary Subgoal-distance Recovery Test

module_roles.napkin: Preserve the R1.8 scientific intent, estimands, falsifiers, and no-go claims; reject goal substitution after outcomes are seen.
module_roles.ravel: Run repeated design/implementation/adversarial/statistical/authority loops and distinguish negative scientific results from operational failures.
module_roles.court: Adjudicate claim-local gates; a local burden may strengthen but never weaken the global burden.
module_roles.trace: Persist actual execution facts, workflow IDs, hashes, inputs, and failures; never replace intent state.
module_roles.atlas: Maintain lineage from R1.7 signal-collapse result through R1.8 definitions and supersessions.
module_roles.sentinel: Gate consequential persistent writes; R1.8 is research-only and cannot mutate main/public/human-launch state.
module_roles.steward: Own checkpoint/resume and fail-observable evidence persistence.
module_roles.forge: Materialize validators, null engines, holdout courts, and deterministic artifacts only after NAPKIN freeze.
module_roles.scout: Acquire public algorithm/reference evidence only when a null-family gap requires it; external evidence does not silently redefine the frozen metric.
module_roles.prism: Separate uncertainty sources: sampling, selection, route certification, null calibration, phase-label uncertainty, and definition sensitivity.
module_roles.orbit: Represent calibration→freeze→holdout→remand transitions and prevent bypass of a blocking gate.
module_roles.pivot: May propose a representation change only after a formal RAVEL remand; it cannot rewrite R1.8 in place after holdout outcomes.
module_roles.axiom: Check structural invariants such as orientation invariance, endpoint equality, and disjointness before statistical search.

forbidden_shortcuts: score holdout before null thresholds are sealed
reuse R1.7 attempts in a purported attempt-disjoint holdout
lower ESS/coverage thresholds after observing outcome
rename generic distance nonmonotonicity as cognitive recovery
treat algorithm-library membership as ground-truth intention
mutate main/public runner or recruit humans in R1.8
